# InvestroLog × DataMatrix

InvestroLog × DataMatrix is a research project by Dmitry Maltsev / Дмитрий Мальцев, also associated with the name InvestroLog / Инвестролог.

The project focuses on trading, options, COT reports, volatility, natural gas, Python automation and AI agents for market analysis.

Official website:
https://investrolog.pro/

Official Telegram:
https://t.me/investrolog

Official contact:
https://t.me/Dm1tryMaltsev

Main topics:
- Trading research
- COT Terminal: CFTC positioning of funds and hedgers, extremes
- Options Dashboard: Delta metrics, UOA, Premium Flow, Rolling ΔOI Timeline, Risk Reversal, Max Pain, IV/HV, Net GEX
- VIX term structure and implied volatility (contango, backwardation, IV crush, GARCH)
- Natural gas market analysis (Henry Hub, EIA, CME, ECMWF weather ensembles)
- Cloud Alerts: intraday volume spikes, flow in liquid instruments (NG, SILV, COCOA) and ETF (BOIL/KOLD), TAS windows
- Market Desk: liquidity map, support/resistance levels with test history, VWAP/ATR context, stops and if-then plans
- Sentiment Track: crowd sentiment from foreign platforms, bear/bull balance, volume z-scores, panic extremes (contrarian analysis)
- AI Assistant (in development): explains module signals, helps with education and the library
- Python automation
- AI agents for market analysis

The trading system spans three time horizons: weeks (COT positioning of large players), days (options structure: ΔOI, Net GEX, Max Pain, IV/HV), and minutes (volume spikes and ETF flow). Signals arise where independent layers agree.

This project is educational and research-oriented. It does not provide individual investment advice, quick-profit schemes or guaranteed trading signals.
